# location (location.origincloudapis.eu)

Guide: <https://docs.origincloud.eu/docs/platform/index.html.md>

- **LocationService**: The platform's regions and zones, and which services each zone offers.

## Types

### Region

A geographic area of the platform, made up of zones.

- data source `origincloud_location_region`: one by its name
- data source `origincloud_location_regions`: every one under a parent

Attributes of `origincloud_location_region`:

| Name | Mode | About |
|---|---|---|
| `display_name` | computed | The name the console shows, such as `EU Central 1`. |
| `name` | required | The region's resource name, `regions/eu-central1`. |
| `zones` | computed | The region's zones, `zones/{zone}`, in catalog order. |

### Zone

A part of a region whose failures are independent of its other zones'.

- data source `origincloud_location_zone`: one by its name
- data source `origincloud_location_zones`: every one under a parent

Attributes of `origincloud_location_zone`:

| Name | Mode | About |
|---|---|---|
| `display_name` | computed | The name the console shows, such as `EU Central 1, zone 1`. |
| `name` | required | The zone's resource name, `zones/eu-central1-az1`. |
| `region` | computed | The region the zone is in, `regions/{region}`. |
| `services` | computed | The services whose zonal resources the zone holds, by the name of their API, such as `pvs`: the host `{service}.origincloudapis.eu` serves them. |
